lines.2: I had done sit-ups, push-ups, running, and all sorts of other exercises.
lines.3: 「I can see that your physical fitness is above average. I will use this to devise your program.」
lines.4: 「You should become capable of at least this much.」
lines.5: She stood on one hand and began doing push-ups.
lines.8: 「It is about time to begin dinner.」
lines.9: 「I can leave dinner to you, correct?」
lines.11: I called the usual guy on my cell phone.
lines.12: 「...Yeah, there's one more person today. Right. Thanks.」
lines.19: 「Sure thing. Time to show you what I can do.」
lines.20: Subaru set to work with brisk efficiency.
lines.21: Otome and I watched him from the table.
lines.22: Subaru chopped the vegetables with quick, practiced strokes.
lines.23: 「Oh! That is splendid, is it not?」
lines.25: 「You'd probably split the cutting board, Otome.」
lines.26: 「How rude. Only about one time in three.」
lines.28: 「Impressive. Date is on the track team, is he not? How unexpected.」
lines.29: 「Cooking has nothing to do with my club... Hah!」
lines.30: He tossed the contents of the frying pan vigorously with a hiss and sizzle.
lines.32: Otome had not stopped being amazed.
lines.33: 「Heh-heh-heh. Well? Amazing, isn't he? Admit defeat?」
lines.35: 「Why are you so proud? I am not praising you.」
lines.36: 「Here you go. Sweet-and-sour cauliflower and pork as the main dish, with a Japanese-style spread.」
lines.39: 「It tastes great even without fancy ingredients, right?」
lines.41: 「There is a vegetable salad as well, so the meal is nutritionally balanced. Splendid. But this leaves me no standing as a woman.」
lines.42: 「This is an excellent opportunity. I will learn to cook, little by little.」
lines.45: 「Your own friend is this skilled. Does that not make you want to learn?」
